name: ZICOS
full_name: Zirconium Complex in Organic liquid Scintillator
summary: ZICOS is a Japanese R&D programme for zirconium-96 double-beta decay in an organic scintillator. It develops zirconium loading and Cherenkov-topology methods; the full detector described in design studies has not been established as operating.
detection_principle: Zirconium complexes dissolve in organic scintillator. Scintillation measures deposited energy, while Cherenkov-light directions can distinguish two-electron events from gamma-induced backgrounds.

science_scope: A neutrinoless decay would violate lepton number. Half-life sensitivity is a forecast unless explicitly reported as an experimental limit; its interpretation as an effective Majorana mass depends on the decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements.
